Mister Rogers returns a scarf to one of Mr. Brewer's puppets which makes the puppet feel brave and strong. Elsie Jean Platypus tells Lady Abelrin that the cereal quit falling on her because she was not afraid of it.

Mister Rogers visits the McFeelys, who are watching after young lambs. Handyman Negri and King Friday put on full cereal-proof armor. When their efforts fail, it is clear that Daniel is the only one who can stop the cereal from falling.

Mister Rogers demonstrates how to use tuning whistles. Daniel has the idea to give the cereal to people who might need food. Neighbor Aber brings a forklift to gather all the boxes. Mr. McFeely brings a video about how people make it.
Mister Rogers remembers a time when he visited Jay Styperk, a para-Olympic swimmer. King Friday's crown has gone missing. He hesitantly enters the castle garden, wearing his swimming cap and goggles.

Mister Rogers uses objects from his kitchen to make a horse sculpture. Prince Tuesday is dressed in a lion costume and startles Mayor Maggie. He explains that wearing the costume helps him feel brave about looking for his father's crown.
Mr. McFeely delivers a video about how people make apple juice. King Friday suggests that Lady Aberlin start looking for his missing crown at the Museum-Go-Round.

Mister Rogers arrives with a fish sculpted from the paper by his friend Ben Gonzales.  Edgar Cooke shares with Lady Aberlin that his refrigerator and food are gone. She finds it, along with King Friday's crown and the Westwood sign.

Bill Nye, “the Science Guy” stops by to show a science experiment using baking soda and vinegar to blow up a balloon. Mister Rogers shows a video of dump trucks at a construction site, and in Make-Believe, all that was lost is found.

Magician David Copperfield teaches Mister Rogers how to do a magic trick. It takes lots of practice. In Make-Believe, X is giving flying lessons, and there's a video of what the world looks like from a bird's point of view.

Prince Tuesday is upset about being unable to fly, so Lady Elaine gives him a propeller hat. He jumps off the castle wall, thinking the hat will make him fly, and injures his arm. Mister Rogers visits the Uptown String Quartet.

X says he is feeling guilty about Prince Tuesday's fall. Neighbor Aber says it was not X's flying lessons that made Prince Tuesday get hurt. Mister Rogers shows a video about people making sleeping bags. He visits the workshop of the doll maker.
Hula-hoop expert Paul Tifford gives Mister Rogers some lessons. It takes a lot of practice to be able to use a hula-hoop well, and falling and getting up again are a part of learning!
Instead of changing into a sweater as he typically does, Mister Rogers puts on a vest made by his friend Saihou Njie. Trolley brings a batik cloth to Handyman Negri, who then gives it to King Friday.

Mister Rogers arrives with a children's plastic potty, takes it to his bathroom and compares it to the adult-sized toilet. Prince Tuesday comes up with a game using a bucket but has had his feelings hurt when his father was not impressed.

King Friday denounces the magic finder balloon. Neighbors Aber and Robert Troll are looking for Lady Elaine. They find her locked in a room of the Museum-Go-Round. At Mister Rogers' house, Levar Burton reads “The Daddy Book.”

Mister Rogers explains how a wheelchair lift works, and then shows one in action. He shows some of his puppets. Mayor Maggie and Neighbor Aber ride in a wheelchair until they have their checkups from Dr. Bill.

Mister Rogers visits with Koko the gorilla, who has learned how to communicate in sign language. In Make-Believe, there's a gorilla, too, who seems scary until the neighbors get to know him. And there's a video of how people make play balls.

At the eye doctor's office, Mister Rogers takes part in a general eye examination. The gorilla catches Lady Aberlin as she stumbles, which alarms Lady Elaine Fairchild. Lady Elaine is determined to catch the gorilla.

Mr. McFeely stops by with a film about a service dog aiding a handicapped child. Mister Rogers visits with the boy from the video and his dog. Lady Elaine Fairchile continues her efforts to catch the gorilla. Neighbor Aber is missing.
Mister Rogers reads a book about a dog named Zak. There's also a video visit to the Center for Creative Play, a place where children of all abilities can play.

Marilyn Barnett brings someone who has great talent with yo-yos. Mister Rogers shows a film of how people make wooden yo-yos. Prince Tuesday plays well with the yo-yo, but King Friday does not. Therefore, the king outlaws yo-yos.

Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely ride with Maria Mancano on a helicopter. Miss Paulificate and Lady Aberlin have been assigned the duty of “yo-yo guard,” responsible for upholding the King's ban on yo-yos.

Mr. McFeely shows a photo album with pictures of Neighbors wearing different hats. Lady Aberlin informs King Friday that Lady Elaine's helicopter, Yo-Yo, is stuck in the air. King Friday commands that all references to yo-yos be removed.

Mister Rogers shows a video of inventor Chuck Hoberman with his sphere and a video of Yo-Yo and Nicholas Ma. The neighbors are waiting for Bob Dog's helicopter to land. They discover that the helicopter responds to guitar music.

Mister Rogers visits Maya Lin at her studio to see how she first makes small models of big things she is working on. They go to Penn Station to see what she created there. In Make-Believe, there's a video visit with cellist Yo-Yo Ma.

Mister Rogers sees a performance by the Westminster Bell Choir and shows how people make bells. Mayor Maggie has a bell that she plays with King Friday and gives to Henrietta as a doorbell. Daniel and H.J. Elephant dress up as astronauts.

Visiting a nearby dance studio, Mister Rogers watches a class of young students learning to use ribbons as part of their dance routine. Henrietta is still ringing her new bell and X the Owl is growing quite frustrated.

Percussionist Tim Adams performs. H.J. Elephant is dressed in his outerspace costume as he tells Lady Aberlin about pretending to fly to the moon. He makes a loud trumpet sound which causes alarm for X and Henrietta.

Mister Rogers shows a video of himself and Sylvia Earle snorkeling in the ocean. Lady Elaine says she is hiding from something they are afraid of from outer space. Mister Rogers suggests when something is scary on TV,  turn it off.

Pica, uno de los oficiales, por fin cae, dejando solo a Doflamingo y Trébol. Pero mientras todos confían en Luffy, Bellamy se le opone con su orgullo en juego. Los dos hombres se enfrentan con sus mentes llenas de emoción.

Aunque está a punto de morir, Law sigue buscando su venganza, pero llega a su fin tras los despiadados disparos de Doflamingo. Cuando Luffy ve el horrible resultado, la última batalla de Dressrosa comienza.

El plan de exterminio de Doflamingo por fin empieza. La jaula de hilos está cortando Dressrosa. Solo queda una hora. Cuando parece que no quedan esperanzas, se desata un ataque con una sola oportunidad.

Doflamingo recibe una herida mortal con el ataque de Law, pero el rey absoluto no cae. Cuando va a darle el golpe final a un paralizado Law, Luffy se le enfrenta y la batalla del máximo Haki por fin empieza.

¡Luffy enfrenta a Trébol, el último oficial en pie! Pero ninguno de sus ataques con Haki funciona, y se ve contra las cuerdas. Cuando Trébol usa su técnica secreta para acabar con todo, Luffy y Law llegan al límite.
¡Luffy pelea con la ambición de Law y las esperanzas de todos a cuestas, pero los poderosos ataques de Doflamingo lo detienen!

La nueva y más poderosa técnica secreta de Luffy estalla finalmente. La habilidad, que aumenta poder, velocidad y todo lo demás, supera a Doflamingo.¡Empieza un violento embate para cambiar las cosas!

El enorme poder del Gear Fourth acorrala a Doflamingo. Cuando parece que Dressrosa será liberada finalmente, Doflamingo contraataca. Un nuevo aspecto de las Frutas del Diablo; se revela su verdadero poder.
Doflamingo convierte los objetos de la ciudad en hilo y lanza un fuerte ataque. Acorralado y con el tiempo límite del Gear Fourth acercándose, Luffy inicia un ataque mortal.

Doflamingo ataca a Luffy, quien usó toda su energía y no puede moverse. Recuperar su Haki le tomará diez minutos. Empieza una intensa batalla para proteger a Luffy de Doflamingo, que se ha vuelto la encarnación de la ira.

Zoro y Franky tratan de detener la Jaula de Pájaros. Pero se encoge más rápido para aplastar su esperanza. La destrucción llegará antes de la recuperación de Luffy, pero brilla una luz milagrosa en Dressrosa.

Luffy aún no ha recuperado su Haki, pero la Jaula de Pájaros sigue su avance ignorando ese hecho. Debido a ello, ya no solo los piratas, sino también la Marina e incluso los habitantes de Dressrosa harán lo imposible por detener su avance.
La Jaula de Pájaros empezó a cortar la Meseta del Rey. Dressrosa se derrumba mientras las voces de la gente se unen por Luffy, su única esperanza.

Luffy regresa y empieza la última batalla contra Doflamingo. El temible Doflamingo trata de manipular a la gente para continuar su reinado, pero cuando Luffy usa el ataque más poderoso de su Gear Fourth, el destino de Dressrosa se decide.
Llenos de sentimientos, Rebecca, Kyros y los ciudadanos ven la Jaula de Pájaros desvanecerse. Sobre las cabezas de los que sobrevivieron al reinado de terror, resuena el nombre del ganador, Lucy.
Hoy, la gente del país se regocija y llora entre los escombros. Sabo arremete furioso contra Burgess, quien se burla de las últimas palabras de Ace.
Las repercusiones de la derrota de Doflamingo reverberan por todo el mundo. Las acciones de Fujitora han puesto a la Marina en una mala posición, y la "Peor Generación" entra en acción.

Aquel día, Sabo zarpó a lo que parecía su muerte segura. ¿Cómo sobrevivió y creció para ser un guerrero del Ejército Revolucionario con Dragon? Por fin se revela la historia desconocida de las memorables aventuras de Sabo.
¿Qué pasó con Sabo cuando Ace murió? ¿Y en qué pensaba cuando apareció frente a Luffy? La sorprendente verdad y la historia del lazo de los hermanos por fin se revela.

Sanji, Nami y los demás que estaban siendo perseguidos por Big Mom pasaron por una gran aventura en una de las islas más extrañas. Al mismo tiempo, frente a Kid y el resto desciende del cielo un pirata que dicen es el más fuerte en cielo, mar y tierra.

Tsuru y Sengoku, dos de los altos cargos de la Marina, aparecen en Dressrosa con la intención de atrapar a Luffy y compañía. No obstante, Fujitora les explica el motivo por el cual aún no ha iniciado el ataque, aunque todo puede cambiar.
El grupo de guerreros del coliseo inicia el plan de huida para evitar que la Marina atrape a los Sombrero de Paja. Mientras tanto, Luffy va al palacio y causa un problema que sacudirá a todo el país.
